question: Does densifying the omega-grid (N_DIRS=200 -> 800) plus full-LC polish and multi-mag-start land Band A inversions on the m048 cohort with no oracle injection?
hypothesis: Densifying N_DIRS to 800 alone fixes the s059j omega-grid quantization failure.
narrative_md: First end-to-end Band A inversions on the m048 cohort with NO oracle injection since the propagator bug. Densifying N_DIRS=200->800 was necessary but insufficient: the local-window polish has phantom basins (rho_local~0.01 but hi-fi rho~50 Band D) regardless of grid density, and the 6% omega-mag grid spacing is the residual killer. The working fix is the triple of densification + full-LC residual polish + multi-mag-start at offsets [0, +/-3, +/-6]%, which lands 4/50 unique Band A clusters on seed 89 (truth basin q0_err 0.86 deg, rho 0.177) and 5/50 Band A-or-B on seed 10. Cohort path GO for the slow-tumbler class.
